description.text: Educational Requirements 1. Good moral qualities and the spirit of devoting, cooperating, developing and innovating; 2. A good command of basic theories and systematic professional knowledge, and understanding of the frontier trends in the profession; 3. The ability of doing management scientific research independently, and the ability of applying professional knowledge to analyze and solve practical problems; 4. the ability of doing statistics analysis, case study, countermeasure analysis and applying qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis; 5. At least one creative research fruit in management science and engineering field; 6. A fairly good grasp of computer. Major Course Optimization Theory and Method Advanced Mathematics Model International Marketing Management Modern Enterprise Institution Advanced Organizational Development Enterprise Risk Mangement Multinational Company Financial Risk Management and Performance Evaluation Operations Management Management Science Management Research Methods Product Innovation Management Strategic Management of Technology and Innovation Duration 3 academic years

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Wuhan University of Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4583 USD/per year ￥ 33000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 7.Health certificate Required during application.Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)

requirements.text: 1. The TOEFL IBT score of 70 points at least, or IELTS score at least 5.5, or the relevant certificates of English as the working and learning language for university study. 2. Completed application form. 3. Notarized Copies of Highest diploma and transcripts. 4. Two recommendation letters. 5. Research Plan 6. Physical Examination Report. 7. Digital photo (Passport size) and photocopy of passport
